Django News Application
  • Troubleshooting

Troubleshooting

Database connection errors

Messages such as Can't connect to MySQL server or Access denied for user mean Django cannot reach the database. Check that:

  • MySQL/MariaDB is running.

  • The news_capstone database exists.

  • DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, DB_HOST, and DB_PORT are set in .env or in the terminal you run Django from, and match the database.

If python manage.py test reports Access denied for test_news_capstone, grant the database user rights to the test database (see Installation). If PyMySQL reports that the cryptography package is required, you are using MySQL 8: run python -m pip install cryptography.

With Docker Compose, the database host is the service name db, not 127.0.0.1. Compose sets this for you.

Missing Python packages

ModuleNotFoundError usually means the virtual environment is not active or the requirements are not installed:

.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

PowerShell will not run a script

If PowerShell reports that running scripts is disabled, allow scripts for the current terminal only:

Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process -ExecutionPolicy Bypass

Or run a single script without changing the policy:

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\build_docs.ps1

py is not recognized

The py launcher is only installed by the python.org installer. Use python instead, and check the version with python --version.

Migration errors

Run python manage.py migrate again after confirming the database is reachable.

Approval says “API logging failed”

When an editor approves an article, the app calls APPROVED_API_URL. The article is still approved if that call fails. Check that the URL points to the running server, for example http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/approved/, and that the server’s address and port match the ones you started it on.
